# cache-prune

The hourly `checks.cache-prune` job: runs `pruneCheckCache` (`checks/core`)
in a supervised child, main only — age-out (14 days), the 20 000-entry cap,
orphaned temps and idle flight files. No check run prunes: the sweep lists the
whole cache, and it used to open every run. Each run logs one line to
`logs/check-cache-prune.jsonl`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The hourly checks.cache-prune job: ages out and caps the shared check-result cache and reclaims idle flight files, so no check run lists the whole cache.
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/jobs/supervised-job.defineSupervisedJob`
    - `primitives/log-channels.defineLogSink`
  - Register: `defineSupervisedJob('checks.cache-prune')`
